card.name: Mid-number and mid-term in dosing text
card.fires_on: Marked word or symbol in the middle of a dose figure or drug term, such as the decimal point in 1.25 mg or 1.73 m2, or the unit after a strength. Also partway through enzyme and drug names such as CYP3A4 or fumarate.

modes.label: Decimal points and units
modes.description: The decimal point inside a number or the mg after a strength in dose or kidney-function text.

modes.label: Inside drug or enzyme names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug, class or enzyme name.

modes.label: Repeated term in interaction or stopping text
modes.description: A repeated noun like lithium, response or dose within a warning or dosing rule.
